title: Israeli attacks on Gaza kill 14, including mourners attending funeral
facts: Israeli attacks across the Gaza Strip killed at least 14 Palestinians on Friday, July 17, 2026.
An Israeli strike in the Al-Balata market area of the Nuseirat refugee camp killed eight people.
At least 20 people were injured in the Israeli strike at the Al-Balata market in Nuseirat.
The strike in Nuseirat targeted mourners gathered outside the Ahmad Yassin Mosque for a funeral procession.
An Israeli drone strike killed a 52-year-old woman near Abu Tammam School in Beit Lahia.
An Israeli attack killed one person and wounded several others in the town of Az-Zawayda in central Gaza.
An Israeli strike on a structure housing displaced people in al-Sawarha killed one person.
An Israeli drone struck an apartment in Gaza City, killing one Palestinian and wounding several others.
A Palestinian woman died from injuries caused by Israeli gunfire southwest of Khan Younis.
The Armed Conflict Location & Event Data project reported that Israeli attacks on Gaza increased starting in May.
Armed Conflict Location & Event Data recorded more than 40 Israeli strikes on Gaza in the previous month.
Israeli newspaper Haaretz reported that 274 children have been killed in Gaza since the ceasefire began.
Haaretz reported that an average of one child per day has been killed in Gaza during the nominal ceasefire period.
The Israeli military confirmed carrying out the central Gaza strike, claiming it targeted a militant cell.
Hamas issued a statement condemning the Israeli strike on the funeral procession in Nuseirat.
